Organisation signup and tenant activation

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Trace bootstrap without circular authority
  • Name activation gates
  • Separate setup from production admission

Technical flow

1. Bootstrap problem

A new organisation has no trusted tenant administrator yet. Signup therefore creates a bounded bootstrap identity and evidence package before normal tenant authority exists.

2. Activation

Regulated-entity identity, product policies, staffing, domains, engine runtimes and conformance results become joined readiness evidence. Partial activation must not silently permit lending.

3. Production is later

Tenant activation makes the platform operable in its approved environment. Production admission additionally requires live integrations, UAT, security and operational assurance.
